files.verifiedPurpose: S0 facade: enforces the pinned {schemaVersion:'v0'} envelope (whole-payload rejection, probed), runs the node loop with duplicate-node rejection, delegates edge/lead records to ingestEdges, merges accepted edges+leads into GraphModel.edges, and emits the count/dist/output summary probes.

files.verifiedPurpose: Pure per-record field/enum validators (checkNode/checkEdge/isObj) returning FieldIssue lists; no probes — ingest.ts/ingestEdges.ts turn issues into probed rejections.

Edge/lead record processor closed over ingest()'s context: shape check, two-sided leads-segregation rejection (ruling 3), dangling-endpoint rejection (placeholder dstId legal), each probed; contains a dead duplicate-edge-id check (seenEdgeIds never populated — documented known bug).

files.verifiedPurpose: S1 capCheck: compares live counts to maxNodes/hardMaxNodes/maxExpanded, picks full/light-only/refuse with rejected branches probed, computes withheld node+edge ids (refuse only, each evented after cap.log), builds the banner (shown whenever mode!=full), and decides viewport culling.

S2 paintVerdicts: maps fill.status to color (unknown = hatched grey, never green), outline null/unknown to grey ring, re-derives worstOf via canonical worstOfVerdict as a verification lead (unrecognized token or mismatch = consistent:false, never a recompute), and emits the per-node histogram firehose.

S3 buildElkGraph: turns the cap-filtered GraphModel into the ElkGraph (layered/DOWN, light 220x64 vs expanded 480x320 boxes, ports FIXED_ORDER only for elkjs), synthesizes ghost placeholder children for legal unresolved-target dstIds on cap-surviving edges, and routes edges through the injectable edgeEncoder seam (the Mermaid-& failure site).

S4 facade/orchestrator: dispatches to runElk or runDagre, probes engine identity/response/per-node+edge outputs/timing, and enforces (not just probes) input-vs-output edge-id multiset equality via enforceEngineEdgeSet before returning.
Shared S4 result/option/output shapes plus engineVersion(), which best-effort reads the engine's package.json version ('unknown' on failure).

elkjs half of S4: uses the injected workerFactory when Worker exists (spawn/message/terminate probed, terminateWorker called before the terminate probe), otherwise bundled main-thread elkjs with the decision probed; normalizeElkResult maps raw output to the ElkResult shape (missing coords become NaN for S5 to catch).
files.notes: Worker:true path is exercised only by the browser demo (workerFactory injection); the vitest suite covers the Node fallback path.

files.verifiedPurpose: dagre half of S4: multigraph keyed by schema edge id, tight-tree ranker, converts dagre center positions to ELK top-left convention and points to ELK-style sections; probes its own worker.decision (always false).
enforceEngineEdgeSet: multiset-compares engine input vs output edge ids, emits layout.error and throws EngineEdgeSetViolation on missing/invented/duplicated ids; exported for direct negative testing.

S5 applyCoords: writes engine coordinates onto RFNodes (missing/NaN coords probed via apply.node.missingCoord, defaulting to 0,0 visibly), builds fixed top/bottom handles for measurement-independent edge rendering, joins surviving edge ids back to schema edges (unmatched ids recorded as phantoms for S6), and paints placeholder ghosts unknown-never-green.
The three named violation Error classes (EdgeSetViolation, NodeSetViolation, LeadPromotionViolation) the render gate throws and the wall rethrows unchanged.

Node side of the S6 gate: per-node render.node/render.node.mode probes + render.node.count, then asserts rendered == schema - cap-withheld + S3-declared ghosts (missing ghosts detected against S3's list, not the rendered array) and throws NodeSetViolation on mismatch.

S6 headless gate: emits per-edge probes, throws LeadPromotionViolation for any resolved:false edge not typed leadEdge, runs the duplicate-aware schema-vs-rendered edge-id equality (only cap.droppedEdgeIds sanctioned, eaten/phantom evented then EdgeSetViolation thrown pre-mount), and closes with viewport/virtualize/timing probes.

runGraphView: orchestrates S0-S7 on one ProbeBus (injectable so probes survive gate throws), admits requested initial expansions through the same probed cap-checked path as interactive expansion, and returns the GraphViewCell handle exposing rfNodes/rfEdges/cap/banner/controller/engine plus the probeCatalog/dump/history/tap quartet.

S7 wireBrushing: subscribes to the bus (subscription contents probed honestly), returns the LinkController whose clickNode/hoverNode emit shared ids out (hover degrades out loud on a hover-less bus) and whose requestExpand/collapseNode enforce the MAX_EXPANDED budget seeded with the cell-granted initial set.
The LinkController and LinkHooks contracts (plus Viewport) for brushing-and-linking; hooks are the DOM layer's late-bound injection points.

Incoming bus->view handlers: filters source==='graph' echoes (probed), probes select in/resolve, branches loudly on unknown ids, reports centered/highlighted true only when a DOM hook actually ran, and applies hover-in highlight without selection change.

The DOM half: mounts only the gate-passed rfNodes/rfEdges in React Flow with the cap banner, routes clicks/hovers through the S7 controller, late-binds centerAndHighlight into cell.linkHooks, emits render.viewport on move, a per-instance render.memo sink, and a setTimeout post-mount render.virtualize reconciliation with domEdges/modelEdges.

The custom React Flow node: fill from the node's own verdict (hatch for unknown), outline ring via boxShadow, provenance line always rendered, empty [data-slot=monaco] div in expanded mode (mount probed), wrapped in React.memo whose comparator IS the render.memo probe via data.memoProbe.
The resolved:false edge renderer: dashed grey 0.6-opacity bezier with an 'unresolved' midpoint label — visually distinct from solid resolved edges.

createGraphViewWall: owns the ProbeBus, probes wall.construct at clock 0, asserts the carried schema pin against gen/pin.ts (refusing as schema-pin-mismatch with bus-only pins whose dump() throws), runs runGraphView unchanged (cell violations probed then rethrown), converts a whole-payload envelope rejection into a named GraphViewWallError with pins attached, and declares wall.face.result from the gated cell state.

The wall's carried identity (WALL_VERSION, literal-copy WALL_SCHEMA_VERSION/HASH asserted equal to the canonical pin by tests), the WallFailureClass/WallPins/WallOptions contracts (capConfig passthrough only), and GraphViewWallError carrying failureClass + pins.

installReactFlowDomShims(): the jsdom ResizeObserver/DOMMatrixReadOnly/offsetWidth+Height/getBBox shims React Flow needs, shared by the DOM test files; imports nothing so the boundary census sweeps it under the production allow-list.

Shared wall-conformance substrate: serve() (the skeleton envelope), pinEvents/solePin reading history only through WallPins, idSet, and standWall(); throws plain Errors instead of importing vitest so it passes the production allow-list.

Test-only substrate: fixture loaders (SKELETON/MERMAID_TRAP), eventsFor/soleEvent/payloadOf probe assertion helpers, and normalizeStream (rounds floats, strips elkjs's $H counter and wallNanos) for the determinism comparisons.

Gate 1: readdirSync census of every src/*.ts(x) file, regex-scans imports/re-exports/dynamic imports against the production (+test-extra) allow-lists, rejects non-literal dynamic imports and forbidden dependency smells, and pins package.json runtime deps to the exact 5-package stack.

Gate 16: asserts all 84 verbatim spec probeIds plus the 9 logged additions are cataloged, every entry self-describing with no duplicates, and a cap-biting run + S7 exercise emits zero uncataloged probeIds.

Phase-0 one-schema gate: hashes packages/schema/schema.json against the PIN via checkPin, asserts the re-exported membrane constants ARE the canonical objects (rulings 1+4 live), and verifies the enum spellings embedded in catalog payloadType strings against the canonical enums.

Gate 15: two runs per fixture produce identical normalized streams, logicalClock increments by exactly 1, every causeId points at an earlier event, and wallNanos is excluded from the normalized assertion surface.

Gates 2/2b: skeleton ingests to the fixed model with the full probe trail (1 edge + 1 lead census), missing-field/bad-enum/dangling rejections are probed with reasons, garbage input survives, and the envelope gate rejects missing/mismatched schemaVersion and misfiled resolved records whole.

Gate 17: the full S0-S7 walking skeleton on the fixture with a mock bus — paint expectations, 2-in/2-out layout, equality gates, brushing round-trips, introspection quartet, live tap via injected bus, and the cap-bite light-only variant.

Gate 9: light-only and refuse modes banner + per-node/per-edge dropped events chained to cap.log, the four-term edge chain reconciles through evented withholding, initial expandedIds go through the same probed admission (no side door), and degraded modes refuse expansion loudly.

Gate 14: the cell declares ceilings 1500/8 with a rationale, a degraded render self-reports (cap.mode, banner, dump, refused expansion), and layout.engine reports honest engine/version/SPDX/worker provenance.

Gates 3/3b/4/5: both mermaid-trap shared-source edges survive the four-term chain; negative encoders (collapsing, duplicating, phantom-injecting) are caught and the merge blocked; a promoted lead throws LeadPromotionViolation; placeholder leads render against ghosts with equality green.

Gates 12/12b/13: round-trip edge counts and finite coordinates, doctored missing coordinate probed, enforceEngineEdgeSet negative-tested for eaten/invented/duplicated ids, and elkjs-vs-dagre cross-check of rendered AND engine-output id sets with honest identities and port constraints.

Gates 10/11: click/hover out reach the mock wire exactly as probed with the echo filtered, multi-select transitions probed, incoming select resolves/centers/branches on unknown ids, subscription contents honest, hover-less bus degrades out loud, and headless centering reports false with a reason.

S6 DOM half (jsdom): mounted nodes carry the honest paint (hatch never green), lead edge dashed + labeled, cap banner appears exactly when cap.log says so, empty Monaco slot mounts and probes, DOM clicks route through S7, post-mount reconciliation matches the model, and the DOM-run stream has no dark leads.

Wall gates E/A/B (jsdom): carried pin equals the canonical pin with the construct/assert/result chain probed, dump() arrays are reference-identical to the cell's gated arrays and set-equal the served envelope, face counts equal the render.*.count pins, and served-unknown renders unknown at pin, face, and mounted-DOM level.

Wall gates C/D/F (node, headless): select in/out through the wall equals the link.* pins and dump().selection with live pins.tap; 'v1' and missing schemaVersion produce the named GraphViewWallError classes with pins attached and no face result; capConfig passthrough stays bannered and the whole stream is cataloged.

Gates 6-8: unknown fill hatches (guard branch + causal chain), null/unknown outline greys, worst-of verification flags declared-vs-derived mismatches, definition ranks to blue (ruling 1), fused 'none/green' is an unrecognized worst token (ruling 4), and the histogram never launders unknown.

Dev-only Vite demo: runs runGraphView on the skeleton fixture with the real bundled ELK Web Worker and a mock bus, renders GraphView beside a polling probe-firehose table, with buttons that simulate editor-side select/hover/expand.
Demo page shell: full-height #root div loading /main.tsx as a module.
Vite client type reference for the demo (enables the ?worker import type).
Vite config for the demo: root=demo, react plugin, strict port 5199.
Vitest config: node environment default (DOM suites opt into jsdom per-file), globals on, src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} include, 30s timeout.

The one-page wall spec: face signatures, verbatim bus shape, pins-vs-face policy, honest-ceiling surface, failure-class table, carried pin, and the conformance contract — all statements verified against wall.ts/wallTypes.ts/eventBus.ts and the two conformance suites.
